contract: v9 engine probe SUMMARY (prereg input, not a fit). Full output and sha256 kept in the off-repo evidence bundle flybrain-v9-evidence-20261010 (probe_v9.json sha256 77469b53b2b9fc174e51be2f7a01de4397e6b88f28f2db2b605d146e1089f158). Source commit e3151840 (flash pin committed before the probe ran).
run: CPU only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty), 4 cores, nice; wall 99.5 s

A_saturation.rule: V9_flash_pin.json conversion_rule_prestated (lowest half-log level with R peak >= 0.90 x peak at 10,000)
A_saturation.disclosure: E_sat VARIES across the free box (31.6 at tau_p0 0.5 ms; 316-1000 at tau_p0 20 ms). Per the pin it stays FIXED at 100 (base, D7); G0 checks saturation at the run's final parameters. Time to peak is non-increasing with level at base and all four corners, so the pin's FAIL-holds-over-the-range argument applies.

B_onset_bounds.setup: fastest free values: tau_p0 0.5 ms, L tau_m 1 ms, no Ih; D 5..11; weights -50, -9.6, -5; flash at E_sat (100) and 10,000 (identical results)
B_onset_bounds.consequence: G3_L (L onset <= 10 ms) at the realistic weight (~-9.6) needs D <= 7; with w=-50, D <= 8. G3_R (R onset <= 10) needs D <= 9 at the fastest tau_p0.

C_R_stage_feasibility.grid: D {7,8} x tau_p0 {0.5,1,2,4.33,8,20} ms x Kt {0.001,...,100} (72 points), flash at E_sat = 100, v8 measure() and train_gates() unchanged
C_R_stage_feasibility.G3_R_true_only_for_tau_p0_ms: <= 2 (R onset 8-10 ms; flash R tp 11-17 ms: G1 fails)
C_R_stage_feasibility.G1_true_only_for_tau_p0_ms: 8 (flash R tp 23-30 ms; R onset 13-14 ms: G3_R fails)
C_R_stage_feasibility.reading: Descriptive, coarse grid. At E_sat no grid point passes the R stage: the onset gate (<= 10 ms) and the time-to-peak gate (>= 23 ms) pull tau_p0 in opposite directions under the fixed n=4 cascade and fixed D. The fit may find interior points the grid misses; the prereg PREDICTS F1_R.
